recentItems.title: 14TH | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
From filmmaker Ava DuVernay, the Academy Award-nominated director of 13TH, comes 14TH, a powerful and timely new documentary that exposes a hidden layer of American culture operating in plain sight. Arriving at a pivotal cultural moment, 14TH enters the conversation as both warning and witness - a reminder that power rarely concedes quietly, and that believing the struggle is over may be the greatest loss yet. Featuring “Makings of Tomorrow” an original song by Brittany Howard and Robert Glasper.

The fight continues. 14TH. In theaters November 27 and on Netflix December 4.

recentItems.title: The Palace of Secrets | Official Teaser | Netflix
recentItems.description:
Madrid, 18th century. Julia Ponce, the daughter of the court painter, arrives at the royal palace and is dazzled by its splendor. There she meets Gonzalo, the crown prince, who has returned to Spain at the king’s command to get married. An impossible, forbidden love blossoms between them, surrounded by intrigue, jealousy and passion, in a court full of ambition, deceit and revenge, where a secret society of women conspires for power.

On January 22, ‘The Palace of Secrets’ premieres on Netflix. Based on the novel by Estefanía Ruiz, the series is created by Carlos de Pando and Sara Antuña and directed by Paco Caballero, Jota Linares and Elena Trapé. A period drama full of romance and intrigue, starring Carla Campra and Carlos Cuevas.
